newsitem.title: USA: Zonagen impotency treatment shows results.
newsitem.headline: Zonagen impotency treatment shows results.

text.p: Zonagen Inc said Tuesady that it has achieved positive results in a Phase III clinical trial of Vasomax, its oral on-demand therapeutic for the treatment of erectile dysfunction.

The company said that 40 percent of men reported improvement during the trial, compared with 17 percent of men on placebos, when the drug was given in 40 mg doses. Side effects were, said Zonagen, mild.

"This data, the first of two pivotal U.S. trials of Vasomax, reaffirms our beliefs regarding the prospects of Vasomax to provide a user-friendly therapy for erectile dysfunction," said Joe Podolski, Zonagen's chief executive. "Once the data from the second trial has been analyzed, we will promptly report its results."

The company said it plans to submit a new drug application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as soon as practical and plans to use clinical trial data to negotiate a marketing agreeement with several major pharmaceutical companies.
Zonagen specializes in products and services for the management of reproductive health, focusing on urology, female health and contraception.
